description: A small red padlock and a matching red key are lying on the pink bedsheet in front of you. The left hand moves in from the left to pick up the padlock while the right hand reaches in from the right to grasp it too, making the padlock a two-hand object as both hands rotate and tug at the shackle as if locking or unlocking it, then both hands lower it and the left hand releases it back onto the bed while the key remains untouched nearby.
